title: Maximum car parking: 2 bays per dwelling averaged across the residential component
text: Maximum parking provision does not exceed 2 bays per dwelling, averaged across the residential component of the development.

replaces.note: double the Table 3.9 minimum -> 2 bays per dwelling averaged

notes: from: ch4p1 C2.3.4 (parking.resident_spaces_per_dwelling_avg: all occupant bays / dwellings). Register C4P2-107: 'double the minimum' of nil would be nil; cap now looser for 1-bed and tighter for 2+ bed in Location B (2.5 -> 2.0). verify: whether visitor bays count toward the maximum ('maximum parking provision'). FACTS.md parking.max_spaces_per_dwelling not used.

verified.note: p46 'Maximum parking provision ... averaged across the residential component' does not say whether visitor bays count toward the 2 bays per dwelling.
